descriptions.subject: lampvein
descriptions.text:
You see a lampvein.
Growth: ripe. Harvest this crop by hand; its produce and saved seed remain here to pick up. The prepared bed can be planted again.

Pale veins spread across the fan, carrying a glow broad enough to work by in a low chamber. The planted crop takes 64 moist rounds to become ripe. Watered crops keep growing while you travel. Harvest by hand, then pick up its lampvein fan and one saved seed. Hold the fan or set it down to cast light farther into the dark. It is covered while stowed.
